reviews.author: Luca
reviews.title: This company is a COMPLETE joke
reviews.text:
This company is a COMPLETE joke. 
You pay for the shipment labels and then the pickups fail. And you have to go through a long procedure to get your money back. TOTALLY unreliable!!!!

reviews.author: Kaiwan Rashid
reviews.title: Very bad experience
reviews.text:
Very bad experience. Nobody seems to know what is going on. I have been trying to return my package for 23 days, and nothing has happened.
They are not transparent and often give misleading information. It takes an extremely long time just to log a package into the system. There is no proper communication channel—only an online chat with employees who do not seem informed and cannot provide clear answers. It even feels like there is no communication between their own teams.
I would never use this service again

reviews.author: Anx Hilc
reviews.title: Very unprofessional and just a hassle!
reviews.text: It's always the same thing with this courier! No accuracy whatsoever, with time of delivery and with handing the package over! So many times they've handed my package to neighbors! Where do I start to find my package? Left or right?! I literally don't know any of my neighbors by name! It would be helpful to even state which house number they've left the package! Oh but no! This courier doesn't give a flying care about that. And I have proof that they don't even ring the bell! If there's an option for me to choose which courier my orders would be delivered by, this courier company would never be one!

reviews.author: ASCHLIN MOUTON
reviews.title: Okay, but delays here and there
reviews.text:
Sometimes the shipping cost is higher than when you first have checked. I removed auto shipping as they use the highest shipping option when you are on auto shipping.

When you manually submit the ship request, you can choose your own shipping, but when you manually submit a ship request, they take longer to ship out your package.

The UK suite is the worse. I have been waiting for 4 days now since my shipment was delivered to my UK suite and has not been captured to date. When I contact myUS, they keep on telling me to wait and wait and that they have high volume of shipments. I have been waiting for 4 days now and it’s an urgent shipment.

The UK suite seems suspicious.

Otherwise, I had great experience with my US suite and I have been receiving all my shipments

reviews.author: Douglas
reviews.title: Good communication and tracking
reviews.text: Good communication and tracking. Great delivery. The only negative is the package was left on the deck in plain view right beside a delivery bin specifically marked for deliveries. 🤷‍♂️

reviews.author: Michael Sprunt
reviews.title: He knocked loud
reviews.text: He knocked loud . But didn’t wait for me to open my door

reviews.author: Battle for fair life
reviews.title: Just declined my subscription with no…
reviews.text: Just declined my subscription with no reason no explanation. Very disappointed

reviews.author: Tony
reviews.title: I had a terrible experience with a…
reviews.text: I had a terrible experience with a driver lieing about a delivery saying no one was in at my workplace.  He left a note saying nobody was on site, yet was able to speak to someone inside. I left a complaint and the next day he returned almost threatening a employee to remove the complaint and was pretty angry about it. This would be the 3rd complaint now in 2 days. I will not use dragonfly delivery anymore.

reviews.author: mikebourn
reviews.title: I’m growing tired of their delivery…
reviews.text:
I’m growing tired of their delivery guys dropping the package, no knock or anything. They may be good in other countries, but in Canada they are lousy.
If I could find an alternative to Amazon I would switch, but first check to see who they use as a delivery service.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Crescenzo
reviews.title: Unacceptable Performance
reviews.text: They were to pick up a package and gave a time window of between 9:45 and 1:45 so I stayed home during this time but they did not arrive.  On calling the office  at 2:00pm I was told that the driver was on number 57 and I was number 95 so it would be another 3 hour window.  Totally unacceptable and they should contact you if they are not able to pick up the item in the time span that they allotted you. Their time is important but my time is just as important.  Would never use in future

reviews.author: Sina
reviews.title: awful unpunctual pick up time
reviews.text: awful unpunctual pick up time, estimate was 12:20pm-4:20pm and now that im leaving this review is 5pm and yet he not here, delivery guy name is Chauhan and sure they need to fire this guy, ppl's time is not to be wasted , if he cant keep up with schedule time to gift his seat to someone else. Shame dragonfly

reviews.author: nuriw itin
reviews.title: Why does Amazon partner with this…
reviews.text:
Why does Amazon partner with this company? I’ll never understand. They attempted to deliver my package once at 21:33 to my workplace and never came back again.

Zero flexibility, zero communication.

reviews.author: E. Timmerije
reviews.title: Worst delivery company ever
reviews.text: Worst delivery company ever! Horrible track and trace, package dumped in front of the house. No delivery options available. Amazon should quit with this company

reviews.author: Alain
reviews.title: Shipment stuck for 10 days in Czech Republic - No help from Support, suite DE19012
reviews.text:
I am extremely disappointed with the current handling of my shipment.
The package arrived in the Czech Republic and according to the tracking, customs clearance was already completed on March 31st. However, since then, there has been no progress for 10 days. The status remains stuck at "waiting to be handed to the last mile courier".
I have contacted MyUS support via WhatsApp multiple times, but I only receive standard phrases and no real help. No one is investigating why the package is not being handed over to DPD.
As a customer, I expect MyUS to take responsibility for their shipping partners (Aramex). I need an official "Tracer" (search request) to be opened immediately to locate my package at the Prague hub.
My Suite Number is DE19012. I hope this public review finally gets someone to look into this case seriously.

reviews.author: mtrocton
reviews.title: Pro in refusing damage and unjust return claims
reviews.text:
They just seem to always find a way not to refund you when a package is returned for no reason or damaged. 
I do framed laser engraving, the latest damage claim was refused because "we do not cover Art with our coverage". 
I didn't know I became picasso. I just don't like my packages to be destroyed and my products too.
BEWARE!

reviews.author: Ruby Lou
reviews.title: This is a scam company
reviews.text: This is a scam company. There is no one phone number to contact, they won't refund unused credit, they won't delete card information, and they require your ID to make purchases. Why would a shipping platform ever need the details on my driver's license? That's absolutely ridiculous.

reviews.author: Christopher Cronk
reviews.title: The package was delivered…
reviews.text: The package was delivered SILENTLY!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Long West
reviews.title: Fraudulent charge
reviews.text: Fraudulent charge. I closed my myUS account a long time ago. Last night in the middle of the night I received a notification that a package had been delivered for me, and I needed to re-open my account to see what it was. I chose the FREE option. They required a $1 credit card confirmation charge, which I paid. Then I saw the package WAS NOT FOR ME. And thought nothing more of it. When I woke up the next morning, they had charged me a further $20. I would like to confirm that I did not authorise any payments, request any services or even ship any packages. How and why they could charge me anything, is beyond me. In any case, I have disputed this as a fraudulent transaction with my bank.

reviews.author: Klaartje Zegtwat
reviews.title: No attention to instructions provided for delivery.
reviews.text: Invariably, deliveries are made after business hours, despite ample indication in the instructions about the (standard!) business hours for accepting deliveries.  Every time I order, I already know I will have to sit through multiple emails that tell me "we attempted to deliver but the business was closed!".  Very frustrating.

reviews.author: Dark Sider
reviews.title: Package always come beat up and they…
reviews.text: Package always come beat up and they never look at the delivery instructions ever!!

reviews.author: Kseniya Kapitonova
reviews.title: The service is getting worse
reviews.text:
The service is getting worse. If you’re not on the most expensive plan, you can’t cancel shipments online, and cancellation requests take up to 24 hours to process. You also have to follow up to make sure the shipment was actually canceled.

On top of that, overnight delivery is not guaranteed by Easyship, even when you pay for next-day service.

reviews.author: Hiago Pauli
reviews.title: My package purchased in the UK was…
reviews.text:
My package purchased in the UK was delivered to my MyUS suite address, but it is not yet showing in my MyUS account. 
According to the courier’s tracking information, the package was delivered on 04/04 and signed for at the warehouse. How long time should I wait more?
Whee is my package MyUs ?? 

 Suite PL3338 
YA835264044GB

reviews.author: Alister Caitlin
reviews.title: One star is generous
reviews.text: One star is generous. They have lost my goods and then won’t reply the WhatsApp messages or when they do reply they close the chat so you have to start again. Made up lies that it was addressed incorrectly- I have the photo from the delivery company the address was correct. you will never get your goods. Don’t trust them!!!

reviews.author: Eric Fogarty
reviews.title: If I could give zero I would
reviews.text: If I could give zero I would, in fact it was so horrific and experience I would give -10, they should not be in business, people don't mind waiting an extra day for delivery but over a week and no delivery and the worse is the lies and deception of the status of your parcel.  None of the reporting is accurate, you punch in your tracking number by phone parcel does not exist, look online and the main intel website status is totally different than their new company website.  When they say delivery done differently they are not kidding, its not done properly that is for sure and I don't know how they are still in business.  Are all these positive reviews by their own people, would not be surprised.

reviews.author: Kandy Schroder
reviews.title: Should be able to provide a zero star review
reviews.text: If a zero star review could be submitted, that’s what I would provide. 2 parcels to be delivered to the same address (both from Amazon) the same week with one being delivered successfully and the other stating ‘incorrect address’. The tracking for the one that states incorrect address was not updated for 4 days, despite several calls to the customer service line, and requests for a call from a supervisor. No supervisor calls returned, and the customer service reps were less than helpful, one even had her dog barking so loud in the background that she obviously could not hear me, as the next rep said no notes had been updated. The parcel tracking now states that further info is needed for customs despite the parcel never leaving Canada, nor should it! So far, no return call and the parcel remains missing.

reviews.author: Maggie
reviews.title: Terrible service, avoid at all costs
reviews.text: Terrible service, inaccurate tracking, unhelpful resolution to missing delayed package delivery, deception about service. Definitely "delivery done different", avoid at all costs, don't know how they can be in business. Avoid at all costs.

reviews.author: Johan Lindén
reviews.title: They kept my money, my fees, and my goods. CEO Ramesh Bulusu ignored me too.
reviews.text:
I paid their fees, I paid for shipping, and I never received my goods. They kept everything and stopped responding to emails entirely.

I escalated all the way to CEO Ramesh Bulusu. Same result: total silence.

Worth noting: Bulusu has publicly stated that MyUS’s mission is to treat every customer’s package “as if it’s our own.” Apparently that includes keeping it.

Avoid completely.
